# Darb

## What it is
A running club's meetups: see the runs coming up this month, say you're coming, and see who else is. Organisers post a run with its meeting place, distance and pace.

## Who it's for
Club members aged 18 to 55, from first-time joggers to half-marathon runners. They check it on their phones on the way to the park and on their laptops when planning the week. About half read Arabic first and half English.

## Platform
A Vue 3 web app (Vite and Vue Router), phone first and also used on laptops, in English and Arabic (Arabic right to left).

## Brand
Named after the Arabic word for a path (درب): friendly and outdoors, with a sense of going together. No logo, colours or fonts yet, and no design files: everything starts here.

## Feel
Energetic, welcoming, sunny, a little playful.

## Apps they like
Strava's club pages, and how plain Meetup's event pages are.

## First screens
A welcome page that says what Darb is and how to join, sign-in with an email address, and a meetups page listing the runs coming up with who is going.
